mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active, and the direction is fixed to positive returns when the rate is low (as defined by historical context).
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, the 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a tight monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS change > 0.1% in 3 months) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE change < -0.2% in 3 months) together signal a strong economy that leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS change > 0.1% and UNRATE change < -0.2% in last 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 310.0), the S&P 500 produces negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 310.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active, and the direction is fixed to positive returns when the rate is low (as defined by historical context).
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.0%, the 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are rising and industrial production (INDPRO) is rising, it signals a strong economy that leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST change > 0.5% and INDPRO change > 0.5% in last 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction signal (HOUST and INDPRO both rising) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 45% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer demand regimes (RSAFS > 700000.0), the S&P 500 produces positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances where RSAFS > 700000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
